task: #50 — per-invocation art params for dummy-effect units + special effects

confidenceContract.CONFIRMED: read literally from the source; subject binding is unambiguous
confidenceContract.INFERRED: required one documented inference; the `why` field names it
confidenceContract.UNRESOLVED: present in the source but not resolvable statically (runtime global, cross-function data flow, or a system trigger with no ability gate)

unitContract.scalePercent: percent of the unit's own w3u base scale (usca). 100 = base.
unitContract.timeScalePercent: animation playback rate, 100 = normal. 15 = 6.7x slow motion.
unitContract.vertexColor: red/green/blue are PERCENT (100 = untinted). The 4th value is TRANSPARENCY percent, 0 = fully opaque; alphaPercent = 100 - it.
unitContract.flyHeight: WC3 world units above ground. rate 0 = instant.
unitContract.distance: WC3 world units. The repo's competing WC3->GGD factors (1/36, 11/600, 1/85) are NOT applied here — raw is the only unambiguous field.
